title: Be Near Me Lord Jesus (Bedtime Prayer)
text:
Be near me, Lord Jesus, I ask you to stay
close by me forever, and love me, I pray.
Bless all the dear children in your tender care,
and fit us for heaven to live with you there.
Amen.
attribution: From the Christmas Carol 'Away in a Manger'
notes: This beloved bedtime prayer comes from the final verse of the Christmas carol 'Away in a Manger.' It's particularly popular with families and children, asking Jesus to stay close during sleep and to bless all children. The prayer emphasizes Jesus's tender care and our hope for eternal life with Him.
description: Beloved bedtime prayer from the Christmas carol 'Away in a Manger'
